job_description:
We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Technical Consultant to support multiple strategic ITSM transformation initiative involving the migration of ServiceNow data, configurations, workflows, integrations, and operational processes to the Salesforce ITSM platform . The consultant will serve as the primary ServiceNow Subject Matter Expert (SME) within the migration program, collaborating closely with migration teams, Salesforce consultants, business stakeholders and client representatives.

The role requires a strong understanding of ServiceNow architecture, data models, workflows, and ITSM processes, along with the ability to analyze, map, and transform ServiceNow components into Salesforce ITSM equivalents. The consultant will actively participate in client workshops, migration planning sessions and technical design discussions to ensure a successful transition.

 Key Responsibilities

 ServiceNow Analysis & Assessment :

 • Act as the ServiceNow technical SME for migration and transformation activities.
• Analyze existing ServiceNow implementations, including :
• Incident Management
• Request Management
• Change Management
• Problem Management
• Knowledge Management
• Service Catalog
• CMDB
• Custom Applications
• Assess ServiceNow configurations, customizations, workflows, integrations, and data structures for migration readiness.
• Document current-state architecture, business processes, data dependencies, and technical configurations.

 Migration & Transformation Support

 • Support migration teams in extracting and validating ServiceNow data and configurations.
• Define migration strategies for :
• Data objects
• Configuration items
• Service Catalog items
• Workflows and business rules
• Approval processes
• Notifications
• Reports and dashboards
• Identify data transformation requirements and potential migration risks.
• Assist in reconciliation, validation, and post-migration verification activities.

 Salesforce ITSM Collaboration

 • Partner with Salesforce ITSM architects, consultants, and developers to map ServiceNow functionality to Salesforce capabilities.
• Define field mappings, object mappings, data relationships, and workflow transformations.
• Translate ServiceNow business processes into Salesforce ITSM workflows and automation frameworks.
• Provide recommendations on process redesign, optimization, and platform alignment.
• Support testing and validation of migrated configurations and workflows within Salesforce.

 Client & Stakeholder Engagement

 • Participate in client workshops, discovery sessions, design reviews, and migration planning meetings.
• Present ServiceNow technical assessments and migration recommendations to stakeholders.
• Serve as the trusted advisor for all ServiceNow-related queries and decisions.
• Collaborate with business users, technical teams, and project leadership throughout the migration lifecycle.

 Documentation & Governance

 • Create and maintain detailed migration documentation.
• Document field mapping matrices, transformation rules, workflow mappings, and technical specifications.
• Support audit, governance, compliance, and change management requirements.
• Contribute to migration runbooks, playbooks, and knowledge transfer activities.

 Required Qualifications

 • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
• 5+ years of hands-on experience with ServiceNow platform administration, development, or consulting.
• Strong understanding of ServiceNow ITSM modules and platform architecture.
• Experience working with :
• ServiceNow Workflows / Flow Designer
• Business Rules
• Script Includes
• Service Catalog
• CMDB
• Integrations and APIs
• Reporting and Dashboards
• Proven experience in platform migrations, upgrades, or transformation programs.
• Strong knowledge of data migration principles and ETL concepts.
• Excellent documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to participate in client-facing discussions and technical workshops.

 Preferred Qualifications

 • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
• ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) ITSM.
• Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud or Salesforce ITSM implementations.
• Familiarity with integration technologies and middleware platforms.
• Experience in ITIL-based service management environments.
• Knowledge of data mapping, transformation, and migration tools.
• Prior experience in ServiceNow-to-Salesforce transformation initiatives is highly desirable.

 Key Skills

 ServiceNow :

 • ServiceNow ITSM
• Flow Designer
• Workflow Engine
• CMDB
• Service Catalog
• Business Rules
• Script Includes
• Client Scripts
• REST/SOAP APIs

 Salesforce Collaboration

 • Salesforce Service Cloud / ITSM
• Data Mapping
• Process Transformation
• Workflow Translation
• Configuration Assessment

 Professional Skills

 • Client Engagement
• Technical Consulting
• Stakeholder Management
• Requirements Analysis
• Documentation
• Problem Solving
• Communication & Presentation Skills

 Success Criteria

 The successful candidate will :

 • Provide expert ServiceNow guidance throughout the migration lifecycle.
• Enable accurate migration of ServiceNow data, configurations, workflows, and processes to Salesforce ITSM.
• Drive effective collaboration between ServiceNow and Salesforce teams.
• Ensure business process continuity and minimize migration risks.
• Serve as the primary ServiceNow technical advisor in client-facing engagements.

Senior Product Manager — ServiceNow (HRSD, Service Catalog, ITSM, Platform & Integrations)

The Opportunity

The Service Enablement team delivers the products and platforms that raise the quality of service delivery across the entire organization. At the heart of this ecosystem sits ServiceNow — powering HR Service Delivery, Service Catalog, IT Service Management, and the platform integrations that connect them into one seamless employee experience.

As a Senior Product Manager for the ServiceNow platform, you'll own the product direction for a mission-critical enterprise ecosystem used across every division. This is a role for someone who wants to advance as an enterprise product leader while shaping how thousands of employees request, receive, and experience services every day — and embedding AI-driven capabilities at the core of that experience.

What's in It for You

 • Own a flagship enterprise platform — drive the vision, strategy, and roadmap for ServiceNow HRSD, Service Catalog, ITSM, and Platform & Integrations end to end.
• Spearhead AI-powered service delivery — bring Now Assist, generative AI, virtual agents, and intelligent workflows into products that ship to a global user base.
• Shape strategy, not just execute it — with the autonomy to define what great service delivery looks like across the organization.
• Grow into enterprise product leadership by mentoring PMs, influencing senior stakeholders, and driving transformative, cross-divisional initiatives.

What You'll Do

Product Leadership & Strategy

 • Define, own, and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for ServiceNow HRSD, Service Catalog, ITSM, and Platform & Integrations — aligned to business goals and customer needs.
• Prioritize features, enhancements, and platform upgrades based on customer impact, business value, and strategic alignment.
• Own the ServiceNow release and upgrade strategy, balancing new capability adoption with platform stability and governance.
• Guide cross-functional teams — platform engineering, developers, architects, and business process owners — in delivering scalable, high-impact solutions.

HRSD, Service Catalog & ITSM Product Ownership

 • Drive the HR Service Delivery roadmap — case and knowledge management, Employee Center, lifecycle events, and journeys — to deliver a consumer-grade employee experience.
• Own the enterprise Service Catalog strategy: catalog governance, item design standards, request fulfillment workflows, and continuous rationalization of the catalog portfolio.
• Lead the ITSM product line — incident, problem, change, request, and CMDB-adjacent processes — driving process maturity, automation, and SLA performance.
• Champion a unified portal and self-service experience that reduces ticket volume and improves deflection through knowledge and automation.

Platform, Integrations & AI

 • Define the platform and integration strategy — IntegrationHub, APIs, MID Servers, and connections to enterprise systems (HCM, ERP, identity, collaboration tools) — ensuring secure, scalable, well-governed data flows.
• Identify opportunities to apply generative and agentic AI — Now Assist, Virtual Agent, predictive intelligence, and intelligent workflows — to streamline operations and boost user productivity.
• Evaluate and integrate cutting-edge capabilities such as LLMs, autonomous agents, and AI-driven decision frameworks into the ServiceNow ecosystem.
• Establish platform governance standards — instance strategy, technical debt management, scoped app vs. global development, and citizen development guardrails.

Customer & Market Insight

 • Develop a deep understanding of employee, HR, IT, and service-desk personas and pain points to drive effective product design.
• Conduct market research and competitive analysis across service management platforms to ensure clear product differentiation and inform build-vs-configure decisions.
• Analyze usage data, deflection rates, CSAT, and customer feedback to continuously optimize features and outcomes.

Execution & Delivery

 • Lead agile delivery — sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives — ensuring timely, high-quality releases across multiple ServiceNow workstreams.
• Define and track KPIs and product OKRs — adoption, self-service deflection, mean time to resolution, catalog fulfillment SLAs, and user satisfaction.
• Collaborate with enterprise stakeholders — HR, IT, Security, and divisional leaders — to maintain alignment throughout the product lifecycle.
• Manage vendor relationships with ServiceNow and implementation partners, including licensing strategy and roadmap alignment.

Team Leadership & Enablement

 • Mentor and develop a high-performing team of product managers and product owners, sharing learnings across the organization.
• Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and customer-centric thinking.
• Champion adoption through training, documentation, communication campaigns, and hands-on support for internal teams and customers.

What You'll Bring

 • 8+ years in product management or similar roles, with a proven track record managing enterprise platforms — including significant hands-on ServiceNow product ownership.

Job Description

 Role Summary & Role Description

 The role is responsible for building, validating, maintaining, and governing end‑to‑end service maps within the CMDB to ensure accurate visibility of business services and their underlying application and infrastructure dependencies. The role supports operational resilience, regulatory compliance (including DORA), incident and change impact analysis, and ongoing BAU governance by ensuring service maps meet defined quality, completeness, and freshness standards.

This role works closely with Application Owners, SMEs, Discovery teams, ServiceNow Operations, and Governance stakeholders to ensure service mapping data is accurate, auditable, and fit for operational and regulatory use cases.

 Service Mapping & CMDB Management

 • Create, enhance, and maintain business service and application service maps using ServiceNow Service Mapping and Discovery capabilities.
• Validate relationships between business services, applications, and underlying configuration items (servers, databases, load balancers, networks, cloud resources).
• Ensure service maps follow approved mapping standards, rubrics, and SOPs.
• Build, maintain, and optimize service maps using a combination of pattern based (top-down) and automated discovery techniques (e.g. Tag based), starting from defined application entry points (URL, IP, load balancer) and leveraging ML assisted, traffic based dependency detection to automatically identify, validate, and maintain accurate end to end service relationships across applications and infrastructure.
• Identify and remediate gaps such as missing relationships, incorrect dependency paths, stale or orphaned CIs.
• Coordinate with Discovery and Infrastructure teams to resolve discovery gaps, CI inaccuracies, and integration issues.
• Perform map validation sessions with Application Owners and SMEs to confirm technical and business accuracy.
• Support iterative refinement cycles and health reviews of service maps.
• Monitor data freshness, CI health, and mapping quality metrics.

 Governance, BAU, Compliance & Automation

 • Support BAU service mapping governance, including tier based recertification cycles and evidence collection.
• Track exceptions, remediation actions, and stakeholder responses related to service map validation.
• Maintain audit ready documentation and evidence to support regulatory and internal control requirements (e.g., DORA).
• Contribute to KPI reporting, dashboards, and management updates on mapping coverage and quality.
• Contribute to ITAM automation by identifying repeatable asset management tasks and supporting automation enhancements that improve data accuracy, lifecycle visibility, and operational efficiency across the asset estate.
• Collaborate cross functionally to identify, prioritize, and deliver automation enhancements, ensuring solutions are scalable, platform aligned, and support BAU efficiency, governance, and audit readiness.

 Core/Must Have Skills

 Strong understanding of Service Mapping concepts, CMDB, and dependency mapping.

Hands‑on experience with ServiceNow (Service Mapping, Discovery, CMDB).

Experience with tag-based service mapping and meta data driven mapping approaches, particularly in cloud environments.

Understanding of IT infrastructure components (servers, databases, networks, cloud services).

Familiarity with ITSM processes (Incident, Change, Problem).

 Good To Have Skills

 ServiceNow Certification (CSA, CIS.SM)

Familiarity with improving mapping outcomes through pattern optimization or extension concepts (where applicable)

Understanding of MID Server setup, health monitoring, and discovery troubleshooting.

 Work Schedule

 Hybrid

 Keywords (If any)

 Service mapping, CMDB, ServiceNow Discovery

 Hyderabad, Bangalore, Pune

Job Description

 Job Overview:

 The ServiceNow ITOM & CMDB Architect is a senior technical leadership role responsible for defining, designing, supporting and governing the enterprise ServiceNow platform, with a strong focus on IT Operations Management (ITOM) and Configuration Management Database (CMDB).

This role will drive the transformation of CMDB into a service-aware, governed, and AI-enabled system of record, enabling end-to-end visibility across business applications, infrastructure, and cloud environments, while supporting automation, proactive operations, and compliance.

 Responsibilities

 Key Task and Responsibilities:

 • Define and drive the architecture roadmap for ServiceNow ITOM and CMDB
• Design scalable solutions across:
 • Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management
• Hybrid/cloud infrastructure environments

• Lead the design and evolution of CMDB data models and CI relationships
• Drive adoption of the Common Service Data Model (CSDM)
• Establish and enforce:
 • Data governance policies
• CI lifecycle management (onboarding, updates, retirement)
• Data quality and reconciliation standards

• Define CMDB ownership model and audit controls
• Ensure CMDB acts as a single source of truth for enterprise IT assets and services
• Integrate CMDB with Monitoring tools, Infrastructure platforms and Security systems
• Ensure seamless alignment between CMDB and ITSM and ensure CI usage is embedded across ITSM processes
• Drive adoption of AI/GenAI capabilities (e.g., ServiceNow Now Assist)
• Act as a trusted advisor and SME for ServiceNow /ITOM architecture

 Qualifications

 Essential Qualification and Education:

 • 10–12 years of IT experience with minimum 7+ years in ServiceNow ITOM / CMDB roles
• Proven experience with:
 • Enterprise-scale CMDB implementations
• ITOM transformation (Discovery, Service Mapping)

• Strong expertise in:
 • ServiceNow ITOM (Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management)
• CMDB, CSDM, CI lifecycle & relationships
• ITSM modules (Incident, Change, Problem)

• Hands-on experience with:
 • APIs, Integration Hub, MID Server
• Cloud platforms (Azure / AWS preferred)
• Monitoring and infrastructure tools

 Certifications (Preferred)

 • ServiceNow CSA (Certified System Administrator)
• CIS-ITOM / CIS-CMDB
• ITIL Foundation
